Definition: from G846 and the same as G3155; self-moved ("automatic"), i.e. spontaneous:--of own accord, of self.
BiblicalUsage: The earth brings forth fruit of herself, first the blade, then the ear, then the full corn, and the iron gate of the prison opened to Peter of its own accord. The word means of itself, without a hand to move it.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the kingdom grows the same way in both verses: quietly, surely, and by a power no hand can see.
